subject: AWS Marketplace private offer — co-sell approval stitching for AcmeHealth
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@acmehealth.com, john.peters@amazon.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + private offer proposal for AcmeHealth

Hi Sarah / John —

Great talking this morning. Per our conversation here's a first-pass private offer for AcmeHealth for the suggested pilot:
- Term: 12 months (pilot scope + 12-month renewal option)
- Price: $120k committed TCV (billed via AWS PO)
- Co-sell: AWS AM to approve co-sell credit allocation per standard AM guidelines

I've attached a draft PO with proposed payment cadence and the buyer approval checklist. If Acme needs a 24-month commitment in exchange for a deeper discount, we can model that — want to understand buyer approval boundaries across your divisions first.

Next steps: can you confirm who needs to sign (procurement + legal + BU lead?) and whether you require a master subscription term? If useful, we can provide a 2-page summary for your legal team.

Attachments: Acme_AWS_PO_Terms_v1.pdf (draft PO)

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192


From: John Peters <john.peters@amazon.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + private offer proposal for AcmeHealth

Vanessa —

Thanks for the draft. Quick notes from the AM side:
- AWS prefers a defined buyer-approval path in the PO so our co-sell credit trigger is clear (e.g., procurement + BU approver + AM concurrence).
- For issuance, we need the private offer to reference the AM's account id and include expected start date.
- Co-sell credit: recommend we plan for a 10% co-sell allocation initially and revise post-pilot.

I'll loop in the regional sales ops if we move to DocuSign. Happy to help shepherd approvals on the AWS side.

Cheers,
John Peters
Account Manager, AWS
john.peters@amazon.com

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmehealth.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, john.peters@amazon.com
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + private offer proposal for AcmeHealth

Vanessa / John —

Thanks for the proposal. Procurement here — a couple of asks before we can progress to legal:
- Term flexibility: our preferred term for pilots that touch PHI is 24 months due to contract review cycle. Would Redwood consider 24 months at a reduced annualized rate?
- Approval routing: we need clarity on which BU heads must sign vs centralized procurement. Currently, procurement + BU security lead + legal will need to sign for any PHI-bearing work.
- Invoices: we prefer quarterly invoices vs one upfront payment.

Attached: Acme_Procurement_Checklist.pdf (procurement checklist). Please let us know a revised offer that addresses term + invoicing.

Thanks,
Sarah Liu
Head of Procurement, AcmeHealth

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Intro + private offer proposal for AcmeHealth

Team —

Quick internal note before we reply to Acme:
- Business constraints: Acme is important strategic target for our healthcare vertical — getting a predictable co-sell path with AWS here is high value.
- Pricing levers: we can (A) keep 12-month term and offer 15% first-year discount with quarterly invoicing, or (B) extend to 24 months with a 22% spread across two years (lower annual price). Option A preserves faster renewal velocity and lower discount exposure.
- Approval flow: recommend we require procurement + BU security lead + AWS AM concurrence for co-sell credit. That matches John's ask and keeps clear sign-off gates.

Action items: Vivek, can you confirm estimated implementation RMU/cost for pilot so we can back into acceptable discount? Marcus, please add a short techno note about any residency or compliance constraints that would affect term length. Vanessa, I'll defer to you on negotiation cadence.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Intro + private offer proposal for AcmeHealth

Kim / team —

Tech note for pricing:
- Deployment: pilot will run in AWS US-West-2, using isolated VPC and KMS-managed keys. No on-prem required for initial scope.
- Cost drivers: token volumes (est. 75M tokens over 6 months) and storage for KV cache. Expected infra cost to us ~ $12k/month for the pilot.

Recommendation: support Option A (12 months + 15% first-year discount) — keeps engineering support window manageable and limits discounting risk. If Acme insists on 24 months, we should price to preserve net present value (suggest 22% spread as Kim noted) and reduce initial co-sell credit to 8% with a re-eval at renewal.

I'll draft a one-paragraph technical appendix for the PO that clarifies data flow and isolation to speed procurement's security review.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@acmehealth.com, sarah.liu@acmehealth.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, john.peters@amazon.com
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + private offer proposal for AcmeHealth

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the clear asks. After internal review we propose the following counter-offer to keep the pilot timeline tight while addressing your term concerns:

Counter-offer summary:
- Term: 12 months (pilot) with a written renewal option that locks in pricing parity for up to 24 months under confirmed usage thresholds.
- Pricing: 15% discount on list for year one (applied to committed $120k TCV).
- Invoicing: quarterly invoicing available per your request.
- Buyer approvals: procurement + BU security lead + AWS AM concurrence required to trigger co-sell credit and finalize the PO. We'll document the exact signers in the PO.

Attachments: Acme_PO_Updated_20270903.pdf (updated PO reflecting quarterly invoicing and term language). DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/DocuSign/Envelope/ABC123def456

If that works for you, we can route the private offer through the AWS marketplace and John will help with the co-sell routing on his end. Legal review OK from our side — happy to provide a condensed two-page technical appendix for your security team (Marcus to draft).

Next steps: please confirm acceptance or propose a single counter-point by EOD Monday and we will kick off DocuSign.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192
